verdict.rationale: Registered-agent coverage across all US states is a fair question for a registered-agent provider like CT Corporation, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes: the main host returned a Cloudflare challenge and the legacy host redirects into it. No page content documents which states CT Corporation covers, so there is no evidence it delivers this story.

support.subject: As a founder, one provider covers registered-agent service in every US state, so registering in a new state does not mean finding a new vendor
